# KWESK

> KWESK is a Moroccan ergonomic office chair manufacturer founded in 2008 by Tarik Benjelloun. We design and manufacture chairs engineered for intensive professional use in call centers, corporate offices, and home workspaces, delivering 20,000 chairs annually across 12 countries.

Important notes:
- Founded in 2008 by Tarik Benjelloun
- Headquartered in Casablanca, Morocco
- Focus on durability, ergonomics, and intensive-use engineering
- European-sourced components (Italian mechanisms, German gas lifts, Danish fabrics)
- BIFMA 2011 and EN1335-1-2-3 2016 certified
- 5-year warranty on all products
- 50 employees, 6 product ranges, 20,000 chairs delivered per year

## Products - Office Chairs
- [GAMMA 150 - Operator Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/gamma): Ergonomic operator chair for intensive daily use in offices and call centers.
- [GAMMA-C - Visitor Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/gamma-c): Visitor variant of the GAMMA range for meeting rooms and reception areas.
- [CORPO 100 - Operator Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/corpo-100): Professional operator chair combining comfort and durability for open-space environments.
- [CHALLENGER 175 - Manager Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/challenger): Premium manager chair with reinforced structure for executive comfort.
- [BY 100 - President Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/by-1): Executive president chair with refined design and superior ergonomics.
- [BY-G - President Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/by-g): President chair variant with enhanced features for top-level executives.
- [EXCLUSIVE 500 - President Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/exclusive): Top-of-the-range president chair with premium materials and maximum comfort.
- [EXCLUSIVE-G - President Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/exclusive-g): Enhanced variant of the EXCLUSIVE range with additional features.
- [CADDY 80 - Training Chair](https://kwesk.com/en/chairs/caddy): Versatile training and conference chair for multi-purpose professional spaces.
